scientific_integrity: The claim is proved by an explicit Fourier average and a compact-time averaging argument for the Jacobi matrix. No numerical finite experiment is used as proof. Literature priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The limit holds for fixed Ω>0 and fixed ε with J₂(2ε)≠0 as a→0+. It does not cover joint limits near zeros of J₂, higher-order corrections, or the full later conjugate-time set.
title: Bessel-weighted caustic asymptotic for a phase-modulated vacuum plane wave
